description: Angular component for rendering and managing a tree node in a UI, including toggle, pin, and expand functionalities.

classes.name: TreeNodeComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for tree node UI with toggle, pin, and expand features.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Updates the CSS class based on the current state whenever input properties change.

methods.name: isPropertiesTreeNode
methods.description: Determines if the current node is a properties tree node based on its class.

methods.name: showPinNodeIcon
methods.description: Checks if the pin icon should be shown based on node type and parent status.

methods.name: toggleTree
methods.description: Emits an event to toggle the tree node's collapsed state.

methods.name: showChevron
methods.description: Determines if the chevron toggle button should be shown.

methods.name: showLeafNodeIcon
methods.description: Determines if the leaf node icon should be shown.

methods.name: expandTree
methods.description: Emits an event to expand the tree node.

methods.name: pinNode
methods.description: Emits an event to pin the node.

methods.name: updateCollapseDiffClass
methods.description: Updates the CSS class based on the diff types of child nodes.

methods.name: getAllDiffTypesOfChildren
methods.description: Recursively collects diff types from all child nodes.
